test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A and B complete a work in 14 days. If A alone can do it in 63 days, then B alone can do it half of the same work in ______________ days.
solution:
**Given:**

(A + B) finish work in 14 days

A alone finishes in 63 days

Find: Time for B alone to do half of the same work

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = LCM(14, 63) = 126 units

⇒ (A + B) efficiency = 126 ÷ 14 = 9 units/day

⇒ A efficiency = 126 ÷ 63 = 2 units/day

⇒ B efficiency = 9 − 2 = 7 units/day

⇒ Half work = 126 ÷ 2 = 63 units

⇒ Time for B = 63 ÷ 7 = 9 days

**∴ B alone will take 9 days to do half of the work.**
